narrative:
Champaign County has 26,327 registered voters, with 16.0% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 37.2% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 42.7%, a modest Democratic lean of 5.4 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 28.6% of registrants.
